expected_input: RGB pixels in 0..255, no normalization in browser before model
original_photo_preprocessing: respect EXIF orientation; center letterbox using aspect-ratio-preserving resize to 224x224, pad RGB(128,128,128)
output: four softmax scores in class_names order; argmax is suggested facility category
limitations: Predicts category of facility only, not damage or severity.
Unknown facilities still receive one of four softmax scores.
No group-aware splitting; independence of unit/location is not guaranteed.
Browser resizing via Canvas is not numerically identical to Pillow LANCZOS; check parity.
